watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Skin density support is a system, not one product. A strong barrier, antioxidants, gentle Vitamin A at night, daily sunscreen, and good inner nutrition all play a part. #MenopauseSkin https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q https://t.co/BqtvHgD3nf

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Daily sunscreen is the step most of us skip and the one that protects the skin you are working so hard to support. Make it a habit this fall. #MenopauseSkin #Sunscreen https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q

drafts_today.text: Sunscreen in October? Yes. UV doesn't take fall off, and mature skin that's working hard to stay firm needs that last step most. One nickel-sized layer every morning, even on grey Sunshine Coast days. #MenopauseSkin #Sunscreen
drafts_today.video_tip: 10-second clip: grey sky out the window, then squeeze a nickel of SPF on your fingertip and pat it on. Caption: 'Cloudy still counts.'

drafts_today.text: Barrier first, always. My winter-dryness reset is three steps: cleanse gently, hydrate on damp skin, seal with a rich cream. Fewer products, less stinging, calmer skin by Friday. #SkinBarrier #WinterSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: Lay out 3 products, then sweep 5 others off the counter. Do each step on camera with a one-word label: Cleanse, Hydrate, Seal.

drafts_today.text: Shopping for the woman who says she needs nothing? A calm-skin set: gentle cleanser, hydrating serum, rich cream. Three steps she'll actually use all winter. DM me and I'll put one together. #giftideas #SkinBarrier
drafts_today.video_tip: Unbox-in-reverse: place the three products into a gift box one by one, close the lid, add a ribbon. Under 15 seconds, soft music.
